items.statement: Customer funds received before remittance and card transactions are completed drive current liabilities and cash balances
items.quote: So basically, our business involves receiving customer funds before underlying remittances and card transactions are completed. So, a substa ntial portion of these balances are associated with that, with the corresponding liabilities which are there

items.statement: New CFO Amit Dhadda appointed with nearly 30 years experience across finance, taxation, audit, corporate reporting and financial control
items.quote: I would like to introduce our newly appointed CFO, Mr. Amit Dhadda. Mr. Dhadda brings nearly 3 decades of experience across finance, taxation, audit, corporate reporting and financial control.

items.statement: Promoter stake increase is discussed regularly and the company will look into increasing stake in the near future, but no buyback plans exist currently.
items.quote: A promoter stake increase is definitely discussed on a regular basis in the company. There are quite a lot of priorities in terms of different projects and strategic initiatives we plan to take in the future. So this is one of the areas we will be looking into, moving step by step closer to increasing our stake in the near future. But there are no plans for a buyback as of now.

items.statement: CFO states H1 FY27 EBITDA is ₹12.5 Cr
items.quote: EBITDA say ₹12.5 Cr for H1 result.

items.statement: Cash and bank balances reached INR104.4 crores at end of Q2 FY27, up 65% year-on-year from INR63.4 crores
items.quote: Cash and bank balances stood at INR104.4 crores as of the end of Quarter 2 FY27, compared with INR93.4 crores (wrongly said, kindly read it as INR63.4 crores) as of Quarter 2 FY26.

items.statement: Cash flow from operations grew 20.6% year-on-year to INR11.6 crores in Q2 FY27
items.quote: Cash flow from operations grew 20.6% year-on-year to INR11.6 crores during the quarter, reflecting continued strength in our cash generation.

items.statement: Future sales commissions will continue as conversion fees for international partners bringing project introductions
items.quote: Yes. In the future also there are certain s ales commissions which will come up because there's a lot of partnerships that many of our international partners bring on the table through their influence in project introductions and the partnerships and consultancies that they bring to us

items.statement: Operating cash flow was INR 41 crore in H1 FY27; other current assets increased from INR 35 crore to INR 75 crore mainly due to vendor advances for H2 execution
items.quote: the group reported an operating cash flow of approximately INR 41 crores for the first half while the other current assets increased from INR 35 crores to INR 75 crores

items.statement: Vendor advances of INR 38 crore drove increase in other current assets; target to return to positive operating cash flow by March 2027
items.quote: the increase in other current assets is mainly because of vendor advances, since our focus is more toward higher revenue in H2, we have to give advances to vendors for supply of materials and equipments. That's how we are planning to build our H2. So there's almost INR 38 crores is towards -- the increase is towards vendor advances

items.statement: Receivables at INR 235 crore gross (INR 226 crore net) at September end; INR 81 crore overdue including INR 25 crore retention; expecting collection of INR 50 crore in coming months
items.quote: the group's receivables stood at approximat ely INR 235 crores at September end. Could you clarify how much was overdue beyond the agreed payment terms and how much of this balance has been collected since then

items.statement: Out of INR 235 crore gross receivables, INR 145 crore not due, INR 81 crore overdue (INR 25 crore retention), working on collecting balance INR 50 crore
items.quote: Out of -- so INR 235 crores are the gross receivables. If we remove the ECL provisioning from it, the net is almost INR 226 crores. Out of which not due is almost INR 145 crores and overdue is somewhere around INR 81 crores of which almost INR 25 crores pertains to retention. The balance INR 50 crores is what we are continuously working on and ensuring that we get the collection against those INR

items.statement: IPO proceeds utilization for working capital, general corporate purposes and inorganic activities to be completed by end of FY27; free cash for acquisitions or working capital
items.quote: So basically out of INR 200 crores as you are aware that we got listed last year. So we have IPO proceeds which have its utilization plan which includes working capital, general corporate purpose and inorganic activity. So those utilization will more or less fall and get completed by end of financial year '27 which is there. The balance cash which is the free cash will be used more towards maybe a

items.statement: Total receivables declined to INR 98 crore from INR 107 crore at end of Q1 FY27
items.quote: Total receivables declined to INR 98 crore from INR 107 crore at the end of quarter one.

items.statement: Management says they may raise funds through preferential shares at some point to fund expansion.
items.quote: Either we go through that, bank is supporting us. We may raise some funds through preferential shares at some point of time.

items.statement: Management states they have managed capex so far through internal surpluses and promoter equity without using debt.
items.quote: So till now we were able to do with our surpluses and some part we have put as promoter equity into the system.

items.statement: Management confirms HDFC Bank has sanctioned a term loan of INR100 crores which has not yet been drawn.
items.quote: And then we have got sanctioned of around INR100 crores debt from HDFC Bank. Whenever required, we will use that also. So, till now, we didn't use any debt.

items.statement: Management plans a preferential issue of around Rs 40-45 crore to fund the AutoPay acquisition, payable by June 2027.
items.quote: And, rest around 40 crore, 40 to 45 crore, or a little over then, depending on the market, which we are supposed to pay in June 2027. We are planning to do a pref round for that as well, right?

items.statement: Unsecured loans from promoter entities are less than INR2 crores.
items.quote: Yes, the total unsecured loan from the promoters, it is not that significant. I think it is less than INR2 crores.

items.statement: Majority of receivables are from government agencies with minimal recovery risk; collections typically complete in H2.
items.quote: Majority of our receivables, they are due from government agencies and this is not only the case for us, but for the entire industry.

items.statement: Working capital cycle expected to shorten to 5-6 months by March FY27 from current 8 months for micro-irrigation.
items.quote: So I think on a consolidated basis, it should come around 5 to 6 months at the end of this financial year.

items.statement: Management expects inventory levels to decrease by March, strengthening the balance sheet without significant additional funding.
items.quote: So that strengthening will come not by additional funds. Okay, as I said, additional funds could be smaller, but it will come by lowering of the inventory levels which we will start seeing from March onward, between February and March.

items.statement: Trade receivable days reduced by around 15 days from approximately 90 days earlier to around 75 days currently; receivables approximately Rs. 30 crore compared with around Rs. 23 crore last year but revenue also increased; on a days-outstan
items.quote: Trade receivable days have reduced by around 15 days, from approximately 90 days earlier to around 75 days currently. The 13 Msafe Equipments Limited 02 November 2026 exact amount is not immediately available. Receivables are approximately Rs. 30 crore compared with around Rs. 23 crore last year, but revenue has also increased. On a days-outstanding basis, collections have improved

items.statement: Management wants to remain cash-flow positive for the full financial year; cash is the most important part of the business and accounting profit alone is not sufficient
items.quote: That is our basic objective. We want to remain cash-flow positive. We are cautious about debt and earnings. Cash is the most important part of the business; accounting profit alone is not sufficient.

items.statement: Receivable days improved from 179 in June 2026 to 150 in September 2026 on trailing 12-month basis
items.quote: On a trailing 12-month basis, our receivable days has improved from about 179 in June '26 to about 150 days in September.

items.statement: Operating cash outflow for H1 FY27 was INR12 crores versus INR37 crores for full FY26
items.quote: Operating cash outflow for the half was INR12 crores against INR37 crores for the whole year of FY26.

items.statement: Collected about INR50 crores after quarter closure; debtor days fell from 193 in March to 150 in September
items.quote: And we have collected about INR50 crores since this -- after closure of this quarte r. Our focus is now to bring debtor days further down

items.statement: Expect to receive entire INR190 crores trade receivables within next 6 months; received INR200 crores in H1
items.quote: Out of INR190 crores, entire INR190 crores we will be re ceiving in 6 months. In last quarter -- how much we have received last quarter? In H1, we have received INR200 crores

items.statement: Inventory buildup in H1 FY27 due to unbilled work-in-progress for NPCI and Bank of Abyssinia, unbilled redemption revenue, and unsold gift voucher inventory
items.quote: So, key reason behind this, like, inventory, it's actually divided into two parts. One is, the work in progress. And then one is inventory with us, right?

items.statement: Merchant promotion revenue billed after 30-45 days due to return/refund periods, contributing to unbilled inventory
items.quote: Third is redemption revenue, which was, Which, the redemption has happened, but, we haven't built it yet, right? So those are the three elements under which.

items.statement: AutoPay acquisition funded 20% via share swap, 40 crore from internal accruals and IPO proceeds, remaining 40-45 crore via preferential round by June 2027
items.quote: Some, around 20% off is through the, share swap, and then, rest of the, like, around 40 crore will be paid by, Our internal, accruals. Which are available in the company, and some IPO proceeds can be used for that as well. And, rest around 40 crore, 40 to 45 crore, or a little over then, depending on the market, which we are supposed to pay in June 2027. We are planning to do a pref round for that

items.statement: Operating cash flow was negative INR9 crores in H1 FY27 due to working capital absorption of INR10 crores
items.quote: H1 FY27 PAT we have recorded about INR5.09 crores and operating cash flow was negative for about negative INR9 crores. So working capital absorbed like INR10 crores in the period.

items.statement: Management expects operating cash flow to remain negative in H2 FY27
items.quote: So can we conclude that cash flow from operations is going to be like negative in H2 also? Sumit Bajaj: Yes.

items.statement: Trade receivables increased 80% YoY with aging of 90-120 days; expected to reduce in H2
items.quote: Our trade receivables increased by almost 80% on a Y-o-Y basis. So why is it so and like what is the aging of these trade receivables? Sumit Bajaj: See, normally our aging is between 90 to 120 days.

items.statement: Inventory levels were higher in H1 FY27 due to replenishment; expected to normalize next year
items.quote: In telecom segment, we service across the country, so we have to have inventory at almost, you know, every location. So that's why our inventory has been a bit higher side.
